messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: deploy blocked: helm release 'payments-api' v3.14.0 -> image promotion to eu-west registry timed out (504). blocking: image tag not found in promoted repo

alex: ugh, that's the image promotion service again?

lina: saw a couple of timeouts earlier from the registry team, yes. latency spikes around 03:00 UTC today.

jamal: can we fall back to the staged image in the staging repo and repoint? risky but quicker than waiting for the registry fix.

sophie: we should avoid changing image pins mid-release unless it's a hotfix. product wants consistency across regions for this release.

alex: Agree with sophie. Two options: 1) pin chart to previous image (v3.13.2) and roll forward later, or 2) hold the release to next change window (tomorrow 09:00 UTC). Which do we prefer?

lina: I'm leaning to hold. Registry flakiness could cause partial rollouts and split-state across clusters. Holding keeps rollback clean. :no_entry_sign:

jamal: holding is fine but we need to notify customers and update release notes to mention the reschedule. I'll draft the note if someone confirms hold.

sre-oncall: If we hold, SRE can attempt a manual promote for the image; I can start the manual push, but no SLA that it'll succeed before window.

product-eng: hold ok from PM side. please include migration instructions in release notes if we later do image pin -> upgrade path.

alex: OK hold confirmed. action items:
- @sre-oncall attempt manual image promote (status by 2765432130)
- @jamal draft a short customer-facing update and add to release notes
- @lina update helm release ticket to mark "hold for registry"
- @sophie prepare changelog blurb and migration steps in case of image pinning

jamal: drafting now, will post in #release-notes-drafts then link here.

sre-oncall: manual promote started. command logs:
```
# attempting manual promotion
registry-cli promote --src=staging/payments-api:3.14.0 --dst=eu-west/payments-api:3.14.0 --timeout=90
# returned: network timeout, retrying
```

lina: thanks. If manual promote fails by 2765432130, we move the change window and assemble release note.

deploy-bot: update: deploy still blocked (image tag not found).

jamal: posted customer message draft: "Payments API release delayed due to registry image propagation issue; we are holding the rollout and will attempt again during the 09:00 UTC change window. No action required on your side." linking to ticket #REL-4721

alex: good. jamal can you add brief 'what changed' and 'expected next steps' bullets?

jamal: added. also attached a one-line rollback plan for support: "if partial rollout observed, run helm rollback payments-api <previous-revision> across region clusters"

sre-oncall: manual promote failed after retries. holding confirmed. I've updated the deploy ticket with logs and attached the promote command output.

sophie: I'll prep the release-notes draft here: - Feature X, - Performance tweak Y, - Known issue: registry propagation delay delayed release. Migration: none expected for customers.

lina: also added an ops checklist for the next window:
```
1. Confirm registry stabilization (sre-oncall)
2. Re-run image promote (sre-oncall)
3. Dry-run helm upgrade with --set image.tag=3.14.0 --timeout 5m --dry-run
4. Start canary in eu-west (10% traffic) -> monitor for 10m
5. If healthy, rollout to remainder; if not, rollback to v3.13.2
```

alex: perfect. last ask: make sure release-notes include the change window timestamp and a note for CS on the delay. jamal/sophie can you coordinate?

jamal: done, linking the draft: <https://rlw/release-notes/drafts/REL-4721>

sre-oncall: logged a follow-up to registry team and CC'd infra. They acknowledged and will monitor overnight.

alex: thanks everyone. moving thread to quiet. we'll reconvene on the change window channel at 09:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
